title: One CUDA kernel per norms call for the shapes a Qwen3.5 step takes
description: The norms slot as torch-norms (its reference and fallback, fused-norms' torch code), with rms_norm (rows, a weight or none, no offset or residual), rms_norm_heads, rms_norm_rope (half-split pairs from inverse frequencies, zeros leaving a pair as it is) and the tanh gelu_mul of gate|up halves each one kernel (code/norms.cu): one block a row, FP32 inside, one rounding, the sum of squares reduced in a fixed order, so a row's bits never depend on the rows beside it; capture-safe. Other calls and shapes go to torch-norms.
